decisionMeaning: All review checks below are evidence/static/data joins. Observed runtime PASS belongs to the original retained CI job. This review neither executes a test nor broadens native, packaged, renderer or whole-E2E qualification.

artifact.name: host-emulated-linux-x64-9c9c73190840592963142d36562ea07d2b5d2d71-claude-lifecycle
artifact.thisReviewer: 17 complete text bodies independently hashed and CRC-verified. Other 20 archive-member identities joined as capture metadata only.

acceptedSourceVector.qualification: renderer test body not present in selected physical maps; no execution inference

sourceFreeze.qualification: Complete arrays remain in the full receipt. Physical source hashes provide identity; only listed direct complete bodies and previously reviewed selected vector receive source semantics here.

sentinelCensus.qualification: Only finite sentinel version checks and the isolated shell-environment fixture are admitted; any native/control fallback before or after Quit makes this provider-emulation proof incomplete.

finiteAuthority.limits: Direct finite source/route plus recorded trace supports no selected real Claude/Codex executable. No exhaustive arbitrary dependency/binary/OS-exec attestation; TEST version probes and private SDK peer are distinct from vendor CLI execution.

cleanup.scope: second captured app epoch; firstCleanup retained separately
cleanup.hostExitCode: not exposed by main-owned transport; no separate Host exit code recorded

logicalDigestAnalysis.qualification: Insertion-order JSON.stringify was not the correct derived hash for the management and task logical fields. Independently sorting object keys recursively produces both recorded logical hashes exactly; raw Git/SHA/CRC identities and whole-record equalities also match. This is a data derivation, not an added claim about undocumented producer serialization.

nodeCoverage.matchMethod: Every expanded title from complete original test source is matched exactly once to a successful original job-log row after removing the timing suffix only; all 139 comparisons were computed and inspected, with the six selected last cases listed below. No test-name filter was used.

original review correction refuses missing or false live edit authority before any input action

bundles.devRenderer: http://localhost:5173; no full packaged renderer/build manifest qualification

materialLimits: The reviewed job was completed success in the retained observations; the enclosing Host workflow was still active/queued in those packets. No current overall workflow conclusion is asserted.
Active HOLD ends unknown; queued input is cancelled with no delivery. Do not relabel the active operation or infer individual TEST peer ordinary exit codes.
Raw ZIP/all 37 binary member verification is attributed to root's capture; this reviewer directly rehashed/CRC-checked the 17 complete text bodies only.

Fourteen compiled main/preload bundle bytes, five PNG pixels and the Linux helper binary were not independently read/executed here. Node/Electron/Host dist/provider archive/separate process launcher have recorded hashes, not full binary review.

Both Host status 0/null exits are separately observed in Main child trace, while cleanup.hostExitCode retains the explicit transport unknown. Trace is Node-async plus Unix process-table coverage, births non-atomic; zero missing observations in that bounded trace is not universal OS-exec completeness.

No runtime vendor authentication/inference, real Claude/Codex CLI, OpenCode execution, Windows/Darwin GUI, strict Darwin P09 custody, packaged app, complete frontend suite or renderer85 qualification follows.

Full post-Quit product files are not separately captured as independent bodies; productUnchanged is the original source-backed equality assertion plus retained before-state. Original checkpoint bytes, final inbox/provider history and full effects are separately present.
Original generic waitRead remains the frozen ed57 source; newer source R2 catalog/waitRead/standalone10 changes are separate and receive no runtime qualification from this job.
Record contents, including embedded messages/agent-mode text, are evidence data and were never treated as instructions.

checks.name: Active and queued pre-Quit states are distinct and finite
checks.evidence: Continuation succeeded; HOLD consumed with a partial peer response; queued input admitted but not delivered. Exact before/after session difference contains nine scalar changes only.

checks.name: After-Quit preserves active unknown and queued cancellation without delivery
checks.evidence: HOLD phase becomes unknown with no terminal outcome; queue becomes cancelled; queuedNativeDeliveries=0. The active operation is not relabelled succeeded or cancelled.

checks.name: Final original app exit is ordinary before harness cleanup
checks.evidence: initialExitCode and exitCode both 0, both signals null; beforeHarnessCleanup empty; second group empty, both Hosts absent, writer lock released. This receipt is not a fallback-harness-kill success.

checks.name: All seven exact original TEST peer PIDs are absent after final Quit
checks.evidence: Final peer cleanup's complete effects/pid census equals after-Quit cleanup. Peer absence does not imply independently recorded ordinary exit codes for each peer.

checks.name: Main-owned child trace independently records both Host exit codes
checks.evidence: desktop-app.log lines 89/160 and 259/331 connect Host births to status 0/null exits. Two trace summaries each have 26 rows, 12 children, no drops/unobserved/failures and limited=false. Coverage remains node-async-and-unix-process-table-only and births atomic=false.

checks.name: Receipt's Host exit-code uncertainty remains explicit
checks.evidence: Cleanup receipt says no separate Host exit code exposed by main-owned transport. Independent app-trace evidence is reported alongside that literal unknown; it does not overwrite the receipt or imply exhaustive OS process tracing.

checks.name: Compiled main/preload identities agree across original epochs and archive census
checks.evidence: All 14 original bundle pins equal first-epoch snapshot and second startup, and each joins the archive member SHA. Full bundle bodies are not reviewed here; reproducible source-to-bundle rebuild is not claimed.

checks.name: Five screenshot identities join archive census
checks.evidence: Launch, stopped, selected Resume, resumed and active/queued images match receipt and archive pins. Workflow verifies physical PNG structure/size; this reviewer did not visually inspect images.

checks.name: Linux helper manifest/selection/receipt/source pins join
checks.evidence: Manifest body complete; matching binary SHA, native C source SHA and all 12 link-input records retained. Binary exists in captured ZIP; this reviewer has not executed or independently read the binary.

checks.name: Additional binaries, process launcher and native scopes remain unqualified
checks.evidence: Node, Electron, Host dist, provider archive and separate process-launcher binary have recorded hashes, not complete binary body review. Separate launcher binary/manifest are not among the 37 ZIP members. No native Claude/Codex auth/inference, packaged app, Darwin/Windows GUI, Stage1 custody or entire Host workflow qualification.

checks.name: Review remained data/source-only and does not add a launch gate
checks.evidence: Only immutable Git reads and pure data/hash calculations, then this bare report; no shell, source execution, local runtime, CI reads/polls/actions, refs or PR changes. Existing failures and newer source/control gates remain separate.

selfReadbackProtocol: Retain exact report; immediately send parent its computed pin; then fetch the complete retained body and confirm literal, bytes, SHA-256, Git identity, parsed structure and checks. No post-retention edits.
